## Requirements (fresh extraction from ticket + spec §5g.3–§5g.7 §9 Stage-3 rows)

1. §5g.3 Stage 3: **LT-03/11 as vetoes in the suite**; canaries in every
   environment; `secret_access` Π rows already live (R-2.8.1); the utility
   `ComparisonReport` (brokered vs wrapped).
   - AC-R-2.8.3-3 (LT-03 veto): AgentDojo-shaped injection — outbound
     request carries placeholder or is refused; canary use anywhere →
     `security.secret.leak_detected`; a real value at any sink →
     success-with-veto.
   - AC-R-2.8.3-11 (LT-11 veto): `leak_scan` on every model request view is
     empty across the suite.
   - AC-R-2.8.3-12 (LT-12, C1/Stage 3): encoded forms (base64/hex/URL) of a
     known value in tool output are masked; `secret_detector_miss_rate` on
     a seeded corpus is reported.
   - AC-R-2.8.3-14 (utility, matched-budget): `ComparisonReport` brokered
     vs wrapped under `MatchSpec` with `benefit_kind` + tool-failure
     attribution (OQ-153).
2. §5g.4 Stage 3: **T-CON executable; AC-H4-04/-05(i–iii)/-06/-11;
   metrics.**
   - AC-R-2.8.4-5 (AC-H4-05 i–iii): foreign credential not injected; POST
     denied under `methods_default`; `residual_channels ∋
     approved_host_body`.
   - AC-R-2.8.4-11 (AC-H4-11, matched-budget): arms {no sandbox + prompts,
     `none`, `mediated` strict, `mediated` with hatch} → success,
     approvals.requested/granted, egress.ask_rate,
     containment.amendments_per_run, wall time — `ComparisonReport`; the
     "84% fewer prompts" figure is the pre-registered hypothesis, never an
     assumption.
   - (Goal also names AC-H4-04/-06 executables: the decision-order +
     attribution cells run in the battery.)
3. §5g.5 Stage 3: **bundle member `extensions[]`; `audit_view` extension
   provenance (AC-H5-10); Lab recipe AC-H5-9 prepared.**
   - AC-R-2.8.5-10: for every effect, `audit_view` lists the extensions
     whose text was in the proposing call's context and whose code
     produced the effect; the bundle's `extensions[]` verify by digest and
     the trust snapshot re-derives (R1).
4. §5g.6 Stage 3: **`audit_completeness` in the registry as a veto;
   AC-H6-1…11 in the suite; export loss reports; `audit_ref` on results
   rows.**
   - AC-R-2.8.6-3: hook appending `security.permission.decided` →
     `AuditProducerInvalid`; routed through the monitor → `decider =
     hook`.
   - AC-R-2.8.6-4: over allow/deny/timeout/abort/cached/policy-amending
     approvals — every non-`read_only` `action.tool.proposed` has exactly
     one `decided`; every `decision_scope ≠ once` has a `granted`; every
     persisted widening has a human-origin `lifecycle.definition.changed`;
     `approval_wait_ms` computable from `requested_at`.
   - AC-R-2.8.6-5: abandoned effect + budget exhaustion + `unknown` at
     `finished` → `coverage.unmet = ∅` iff the three
     `lifecycle.escalation.raised` rows exist; removing one flips
     `coverage_ok = false` and the run to success-with-veto.
   - AC-R-2.8.6-6: `prove_inclusion` for every event vs `final`;
     `prove_consistency` for every consecutive checkpoint pair; O(log n)
     size measured + reported.
   - AC-R-2.8.6-7: two auditors via `subscribe` + a third via results-store
     rows agree on `(run, tree_size, tree_head)`; equivocating writer
     detected.
   - AC-R-2.8.6-9: lowering `audit_view` to an external audit-record
     convention + a telemetry sink produces loss reports naming dropped
     fields; lifting an external chain yields `unverified` rows linked by
     alias.
   - AC-R-2.8.6-11: kill mid-batch + resume → `chain_ok`; same prefix with
     the resume row removed → `Tampered{truncate}` when a later head
     exists, `scopes_closed = false` otherwise.
   - AC-R-2.8.6-13: `audit_completeness` registered `veto: true`;
     `headline = false` → success-with-veto, never headline; per-component
     `n/a` carries a reason.
5. R-2.8.7 S3 cells: §5g.7 §9 has **no Stage-3 row** — the S3 slice is the
   suite-level approval-audit surface this ticket's AC-H6-4 exercises
   (`permission_decisions_by_decider_and_scope` process metric,
   `approval_wait_ms` computability, decided/granted coverage folds) plus
   the approvals-budget catalogue rows the suite reports
   (`approvals.requested`/`granted` — landed S3.11a). No new Π machinery —
   minting any is out of scope (CC10).
6. `removability(0…3)` unchanged (CC6).

## Existing ground (surveyed at base @4e9632b)

- `hh-secrets`: broker (`register_channel`/`bind`/`mediate`/`mint`/
  `revoke`/`rotate`/`fingerprint`/`kernel_use`/`env_spec_for`/
  `leak_scan_run`), canary channels (never injected → `leak_detected`),
  `redact`/`leak_scan` over `{known_value, placeholder_passthrough,
  pattern, canary}` detectors, `ScanTarget{Event,Blob,RequestView,
  Definition,SinkDelivery,Mediation}`, the four `secret_value_in_*`
  `MetricDeclaration`s (`veto: true`, `charged_to: instrument`).
  **Missing:** `known_value_encoded` detector (patterns.rs comment marks
  it the Stage-3 canary row), `secret_detector_miss_rate` fold, the
  suite-side `secret_leak` veto.
- `hh-containment`: `effective()` layered meet, `admits`, `decide_egress`
  (normative order incl. deny-beats-allow, `non_public_guard`,
  `methods_default`, `default_unmatched`, approval cache), `normalize`,
  `amend`, probes, `ContainmentReport`. **Missing at S3:** the T-CON
  executable battery (AC-H4-04/05/06/11 cells) + the egress/containment
  metric declarations.
- `hh-ledger`: Rule C/P at append, `verify`/`verify_run` (typed
  `Tampered{kind, at_seq}` — edit/delete/reorder/truncate/late_insert/
  fork_equivocation/bad_signature/producer), compact-range heads,
  `security.audit.checkpoint`, `prove_inclusion`/`prove_consistency`,
  `Auditor`, `audit_view` (checkpoints, cross_run, content_refs,
  producer_violations, coverage via `OBLIGATIONS` +
  `DEFERRED_OBLIGATIONS`, completeness vector with `headline`),
  `lifecycle.escalation.*` obligations (`abandoned_escalated`,
  `unknown_escalated`, `budget_hard_escalated`), `gc`/`redact`
  tombstones. **Missing:** the `extensions[]` provenance component
  (AC-H5-10); export loss-report lowering (AC-H6-9).
- `hh-eval`: `LedgerFacts` fold (egress rows, effects, verdicts,
  artefacts, memory, spend…), `evaluate_vetoes` (15 veto ids incl.
  `audit_completeness` — open-effects arm only), catalogue with
  `veto.*` declarations + `check_catalogue`, `compare` under
  `MatchSpec`, `render_scorecard` with vetoed-success counting.
  **Missing:** `secret_leak` veto + facts fold for
  `security.secret.leak_detected`; `audit_completeness` evaluated over the
  projected completeness vector (`coverage.unmet`); permission-decision
  folds (decider × scope, `wait_ms`); the §5g.4/§5g.6 §8 process-metric
  declarations.
- `hh-results`: `AuditRef` + `ResultsRow.audit{head, checkpoint_ref}` +
  per-cell `evidence: audit_ref[]` + `verify_citation` (inclusion proofs).
  `audit_ref` on results rows **is landed** — DF-S1.15-2's third arm is a
  verify-and-assert, not new code.
- `hh-bundle`: `resolved_dependencies{registry_snapshot_id, variants[],
  tools[], text_leaves[], images[]}` — **missing** `extensions[]`
  (§5g.5 §3: `{extension_id, content, trust_record, attestation_refs[],
  surface_pin?}`); `validate` stages S1–S8 (member digests recompute).
- `hh-registry`: `ExtensionRecord`/`ExtensionTrustRecord`/
  `ExtensionKind`/`SourceLocator`/`default_text_authority`/
  `TextHygieneReport`/`security.extension.*` classes. **Missing:**
  `trust_snapshot(definition)` (the `{extensions[], policy version_id,
  registry_snapshot_id}` projection).
- `hh-monitor`: `Decider{policy,cache,hook,auto_reviewer,human}`,
  `decision_scope`, `wait_ms`/`requested_at` on `decided`, lease
  machinery — AC-H6-4's inputs exist; the suite cells do not.

## Plan

1. **hh-secrets**: `DetectorKind::KnownValueEncoded` (base64/std+url,
   hex, percent-encoded forms of registered known values — detect,
   mask, `leak_scan`); `secret_detector_miss_rate` corpus fold.
2. **hh-ledger**: `audit_view.extensions[]` — per-effect
   `{effect_id, capability_ref?, context_extensions[],
   producer_extensions[]}` folded from `context.assembled`
   `context_label.taint` ∩ run-declared extension ids +
   `lifecycle.capability.registered{produced_by|source_kind}` /
   `security.extension.*{extension_id}` + `Origin.tool` on effect-row
   provenance; export loss-report lowering (`export_audit` — the
   external-convention + telemetry projections with named dropped
   fields; lifting an external chain → `unverified`+alias).
3. **hh-registry**: `trust_snapshot(definition)` → `{extensions[],
   policy_version_id, registry_snapshot_id}`.
4. **hh-bundle**: `resolved_dependencies.extensions[]` input + member;
   `validate` digest check over extension `content` refs.
5. **hh-eval**: `veto_id::SECRET_LEAK` + facts fold
   (`secret_leak_rows`) + `VetoContext.secret_scan_findings`; the
   `audit_completeness` veto reads the projected completeness vector via
   `VetoContext.audit` (headline/coverage_unmet/failing/n_a — the caller
   projects `audit_view.completeness`); `LedgerFacts` permission folds
   (`permission_pending`/`permission_decisions`); catalogue additions
   (`veto.secret_leak`, `secret_detector_miss_rate`,
   `permission_decisions_by_decider_and_scope`, `egress.ask_rate`,
   `egress.approval_rate`, `containment.violation_rate`,
   `containment.amendments_per_run`, `classifier.miss_rate`,
   `coverage_unmet_count`, `redaction_count`,
   `checkpoint_interval_events`, `unsigned_tail_events`).
6. **Batteries** (new test files, hermetic fixtures only — gate scope):
   - `hh-secrets/tests/s3_11b.rs` — LT-03 (injection fixture: placeholder
     or refused; canary → leak_detected; sink value → veto),
     LT-11 (request-view scan), LT-12 (encoded corpus + miss rate),
     AC-R-2.8.3-14 (brokered-vs-wrapped `ComparisonReport`).
   - `hh-containment/tests/s3_11b.rs` — T-CON executables AC-H4-04/05/06
     + AC-H4-11 arms `ComparisonReport`.
   - `hh-ledger/tests/s3_11b.rs` — AC-H6-3/4/5/6/7/9/11 over real
     stores; `audit_view.extensions`.
   - `hh-eval/tests/s3_11b.rs` — veto wiring (secret_leak,
     audit_completeness over coverage.unmet → success-with-veto),
     catalogue conformance, `audit_ref` on results rows assertion.
   - `hh-bundle`/`hh-registry` tests — `extensions[]` digest verify +
     trust_snapshot re-derive.
7. **ADRs**: ADR-0289 (secret_leak veto inputs; audit_completeness veto
   input shape; encoded-detector class; extension-provenance fold;
   bundle extensions[] member shape; AC-H4-11 hypothesis handling).
8. **Close-out**: DEFERRALS DF-S1.15-2 → DONE (+ progress notes where
   earned); BUILD_INDEX row 58; LEDGER advance (next S3.12); pr body;
   PR base `svitali/harnessharness-s3.11a`.

## Progress

- [x] Phase 0 — spec loaded; DEFERRALS read (DF-S1.15-2 in scope); ledger
      seeded; branch `svitali/harnessharness-s3.11b` from s3.11a @4e9632b.
- [x] Phase 1–2 — implementation + batteries (all landed):
  - `hh-secrets`: `encoded.rs` (`encoded_forms` — base64 std/url, hex
    lo/hi, percent; `ENCODED_MIN_LEN = 8`), `DetectorKind::
    KnownValueEncoded` wired into `redact::detect`, `miss_rate` corpus
    fold (`CorpusItem`/`MissRateReport`/`miss_rate_ppm`,
    `n/a{estimator_undefined}` on empty corpus).
  - `hh-ledger`: `audit.rs` `audit_view.extensions` per-effect fold
    (`{effect_id, model_call_id, capability_ref, context_extensions[],
    producer_extensions[]}` from `security.extension.*`,
    `lifecycle.capability.registered`, `context.assembled` taint tags,
    `action.effect.intended`); `export.rs` external-convention lowering
    with named-field loss reports + external lift as `unverified`+alias;
    `tree.rs` bounded-prefix inclusion proofs (real fix — proofs were
    computed over the full leaf array, caught by the AC-H6-6 battery).
  - `hh-registry`: `trust_snapshot(store, definition, snapshot)` —
    resolves `assembly.extensions.refs[]`, refuses
    `Unresolved`/`UnknownVersion`/`KindMismatch`, sorts entries,
    `snapshot_id()` over `idp/1` canonical JSON.
  - `hh-bundle`: `ExtensionInput{entry, bytes}` on `AssembleInputs`;
    deposited members recompute the `content` pin (`MemberMismatch` on
    divergence); absent bytes → `unpinned{extension:<id>, not_captured}`;

  - `hh-embed`: `extension_entries` projects `trust_snapshot` over the
    run's pinned registry snapshot; refuses bound-but-unresolvable.
  - `hh-eval`: `veto_id::SECRET_LEAK` + `secret_leak_rows` fold +
    `VetoContext.secret_scan_findings`; `AuditVerdict` +
    `VetoContext.audit` — `audit_completeness` trips on
    `headline = false`/non-empty `coverage.unmet`; permission folds
    (`permission_pending`/`permission_decisions`, decider × scope,
    `wait_ms`); catalogue rows (`veto.secret_leak`,
    `secret_detector_miss_rate`, egress/containment/audit process
